explanation.summary: VALDRES HYTTE OG BYGGSERVICE AS (913 786 866), a private limited company, is an active entity in Enhetsregisteret; founded 2014-05-25; address Espelibygde 447, 2890 ETNEDAL, Norge. Main industry is 41.000 Oppføring av bygninger; 13 registered employees; 1 registered sub-unit(s). Daily manager: Bjørn Mikael Småladen Espelien; Board chair: Joachim Sveen; Auditor: RRO AS. Accounts for 2025 (period ending 2025-12-31): revenue NOK 12.10 m, operating profit NOK 261.42 k, net profit NOK 207.97 k, equity NOK 2.30 m, total assets NOK 4.35 m. Website https://www.vhbs.no shows the registered name.
